content.focus: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy including diagnosis, management, and imaging techniques.

sections.title: CMR Imaging
sections.description: The role of cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) in the evaluation and management of patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

sections.title: Genetic Counseling
sections.description: Discussion on the genetic considerations and the importance of genetic testing in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

sections.title: Surgical Treatment
sections.description: Approaches and long-term outcomes of surgical strategies such as septal myectomy.

genes.context: In the context of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, mutations in genes such as MYBPC3 are significant in diagnosis and management.
Mutations in the MYH7 gene have been identified in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and are relevant for familial screening.
